label: first token is f (t=0, input f)
explanation: Fires only at step 0 when the input token is the letter f, i.e. on the first token of sequences starting with f. It fires on every such sequence at a constant magnitude (0.957), so nothing modulates its size. It does not fire on f at later positions, at step 0 for any other token, or anywhere in the delimiter or copy phases. Dev split: precision, recall and F1 are all 1.0.

issues: None found. I ran the profile, the test-split score and the test-split misses check. On test: precision 1.0, recall 1.0, F1 1.0, mass recall about 1.0, correlation about 1.0, with 16729 active steps and the same 16729 predicted.
Misses on test: 0 missed activations and 0 false positives.

Profile (dev split): all activation is in the original phase at t=0 (orig_idx 0). There are no activations at t>=1, in the delimiter phase or in the copy phase. Magnitude is constant: mean, median and max are all 0.957. This matches every claim in the explanation.
The by-L breakdown shows no length dependence beyond t=0 being present in every sequence.
